system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
Frame and Ruin are not opposite. They are partners. Today they take the same step.

The Third Door — 1/scene (recovers on Soma Break). As part of any single action on your turn, you may spend any number of Frame Dice and Ruin Charges together. They do not compete for the same action-economy slot:

  • Each Frame Die spent contributes to the action's defensive component (absorbing the next incoming hit through the same action, or fueling a doctrine effect's defensive side).

  • Each Ruin Charge spent contributes to the action's offensive component (damage, force, or doctrine effect's offensive side).

  • The spends do not displace each other and do not require separate action-economy.

Example: you may strike a target (Ruin), absorb the counterattack from that target (Frame), and pull off both effects in a single attack action.

system.requirements: Path of the Cataclyst, Bulwark Initiation 13
